statement: The function returns a result r. Let n = len(words). For each byte b, let C(b) be the total number of occurrences of b across all words (sum over i of the count of b in words[i]). Let P = sum over all bytes b of floor(C(b)/2), and O = sum over all bytes b of (C(b) mod 2). For a subset S ⊆ {0,1,...,n-1}, define A(S) = sum over i in S of floor(len(words[i])/2), and m(S) = the number of i in S such that len(words[i]) is odd. Then r is the maximum cardinality |S| over all subsets S of {0,1,...,n-1} for which there exists an integer t ≥ 0 satisfying A(S) + t ≤ P and m(S) ≤ O + 2t.
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(words) ≤ 1000; for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(words), 1 ≤ len(words[i]) ≤ 100; every byte in every words[i] is a lowercase English letter (ASCII 97–122).

statement: The function returns a result r with 0 ≤ r ≤ len(words).
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(words) ≤ 1000; for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(words), 1 ≤ len(words[i]) ≤ 100; every byte in every words[i] is a lowercase English letter (ASCII 97–122).

statement: The function returns a result (i.e., it does not fail: no overflow, out-of-bounds, or panic).
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(words) ≤ 1000; for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(words), 1 ≤ len(words[i]) ≤ 100; every byte in every words[i] is a lowercase English letter (ASCII 97–122).

statement: Let w = words[0]. Let odd(w) be the number of bytes b such that the count of b in w is odd. Then r = 1 if odd(w) ≤ 1, and r = 0 otherwise.
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(words) ≤ 1000; for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(words), 1 ≤ len(words[i]) ≤ 100; every byte in every words[i] is a lowercase English letter (ASCII 97–122); len(words) = 1.

statement: For any permutation π of {0,1,...,n-1} (where n = len(words)), let words' be the list defined by words'[i] = words[π(i)] for 0 ≤ i < n. Then the result of the function on words' equals the result on words.
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(words) ≤ 1000; for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(words), 1 ≤ len(words[i]) ≤ 100; every byte in every words[i] is a lowercase English letter (ASCII 97–122).

statement: Let n = len(words). Then r ≥ the number of indices i with 0 ≤ i < n such that words[i] is a palindrome, i.e., for all j with 0 ≤ j < len(words[i]), words[i][j] = words[i][len(words[i]) - 1 - j].
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(words) ≤ 1000; for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(words), 1 ≤ len(words[i]) ≤ 100; every byte in every words[i] is a lowercase English letter (ASCII 97–122).

statement: Let C(b) be the total number of occurrences of byte b across all words, and let P = sum over all bytes b of floor(C(b)/2). If P = 0, then r equals the number of indices i with len(words[i]) = 1.
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(words) ≤ 1000; for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(words), 1 ≤ len(words[i]) ≤ 100; every byte in every words[i] is a lowercase English letter (ASCII 97–122).

1 ≤ len(words) ≤ 1000; for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(words), 1 ≤ len(words[i]) ≤ 100; every byte in every words[i] is a lowercase English letter (ASCII 97–122); for all i with 0 ≤ i < len(words), len(words[i]) = 1.

statement: There exists a partition of the total multiset of characters in words into multisets M_0, M_1, ..., M_{n-1} (where n = len(words)) such that for each i, |M_i| = len(words[i]), the disjoint union of all M_i equals the total multiset of characters in words, and the number of indices i for which M_i has at most one byte with odd multiplicity is exactly r.
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(words) ≤ 1000; for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(words), 1 ≤ len(words[i]) ≤ 100; every byte in every words[i] is a lowercase English letter (ASCII 97–122).

statement: For every partition of the total multiset of characters in words into multisets M_0, M_1, ..., M_{n-1} such that |M_i| = len(words[i]) for all i and the disjoint union is the total multiset, the number of indices i for which M_i has at most one byte with odd multiplicity is at most r.
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(words) ≤ 1000; for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(words), 1 ≤ len(words[i]) ≤ 100; every byte in every words[i] is a lowercase English letter (ASCII 97–122).

statement: For any list of words' such that for each i with 0 ≤ i < len(words), words'[i] is a permutation of words[i] (i.e., same length and same multiset of bytes), the result of the function on words' equals the result on words.
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(words) ≤ 1000; for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(words), 1 ≤ len(words[i]) ≤ 100; every byte in every words[i] is a lowercase English letter (ASCII 97–122).

statement: If there exists a byte b such that every byte in every words[i] equals b, then r = len(words).
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(words) ≤ 1000; for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(words), 1 ≤ len(words[i]) ≤ 100; every byte in every words[i] is a lowercase English letter (ASCII 97–122).

statement: Let P be the total number of pairs of identical characters across all words, i.e., P = sum over bytes b of floor(C(b)/2). Then r = min(len(words), P).
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(words) ≤ 1000; for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(words), 1 ≤ len(words[i]) ≤ 100; every byte in every words[i] is a lowercase English letter (ASCII 97–122); for all i with 0 ≤ i < len(words), len(words[i]) = 2.

statement: Let r be the result of the function on words, and r' the result on words'. Then r' ≥ r.
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(words) ≤ 1000; for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(words), 1 ≤ len(words[i]) ≤ 100; every byte in every words[i] is a lowercase English letter (ASCII 97–122). Choose an index k with 0 ≤ k < len(words) and a lowercase English letter b (ASCII 97–122) such that len(words[k]) + 2 ≤ 100. Let words' be obtained from words by replacing words[k] with words[k] followed by b, b. (Then words' also satisfies the same input constraints.)

statement: Let O be the total number of bytes with odd total count across all words, i.e., O = sum over bytes b of (C(b) mod 2). If O = 0, then r = len(words).
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(words) ≤ 1000; for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(words), 1 ≤ len(words[i]) ≤ 100; every byte in every words[i] is a lowercase English letter (ASCII 97–122).

statement: For any two valid inputs words and words' with the same multiset of word lengths and the same total multiset of bytes across all words, the result on words equals the result on words'.
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(words) ≤ 1000; for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(words), 1 ≤ len(words[i]) ≤ 100; every byte in every words[i] is a lowercase English letter (ASCII 97–122).

statement: If words' is words with w appended as an additional word, so len(words') = len(words)+1, then the result of the function on words' is at least the result on words.
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(words) < 1000; for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(words), 1 ≤ len(words[i]) ≤ 100; every byte in every words[i] is a lowercase English letter (ASCII 97–122); let w be any nonempty string of lowercase English letters with 1 ≤ len(w) ≤ 100.

statement: Let n = len(words), let P and O be as in spec_1, let A_total = sum_{i=0}^{n-1} floor(len(words[i])/2), and let m_total be the number of indices i with len(words[i]) odd. Then r = n if and only if there exists an integer t ≥ 0 such that A_total + t ≤ P and m_total ≤ O + 2t.
preconditions: 1 ≤ len(words) ≤ 1000; for every i with 0 ≤ i < len(words), 1 ≤ len(words[i]) ≤ 100; every byte in every words[i] is a lowercase English letter (ASCII 97–122).
